confirmedFindings.title: Integer Truncation in Jitter Clock Drift Math
confirmedFindings.body: Premature Math.floor integer truncation in the per-sample clock skew calculation zeros out sub-millisecond network jitter drift, preventing the adaptive jitter buffer from detecting gradual clock divergence.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Preserve floating-point precision during per-sample skew accumulation.
